p: I returned: He makes here another discourse with himself concerning the tyranny of them that oppressed the poor.
dead who are already dead more: Because they are no longer subject to these oppressions.
better is he than both they: He speaks according to the judgment of the flesh which cannot abide to feel or see troubles.
right work: The more perfect that the work is, the more it is envied by the wicked.
eateth his own flesh: For idleness he is compelled to destroy himself.

Two are better than one: As when man is alone, he can neither help himself nor others, he shows that men should live in mutual society to the intent that they may be profitable one to another, and that their things may increase.
cord is not quickly broken: By this proverb he declares how necessary it is, that men should live in society.
prison he cometh to reign: That is, from a poor and base estate or out of trouble and prison as Joseph did, Ge 41:14.
born in his kingdom becometh poor: Meaning, that is born a king.
with the second child that shall: Who follow and flatter the king's son, or him that will succeed to enter into credit with them in hope of gain.

end of all the people: They never cease by all means to creep into favour, but when they do not obtain their greedy desires they think themselves abused, as others have been in times past, and so care no more for him.
